headline: Ideas become editable.
one_sentence: Vixl is a design engine for AI agents: it builds graphics, documents and motion out of real layers, checks its own work, and hands you the editable master.
short_description: Give your agent a design engine instead of a picture generator. Vixl turns edits into atomic operations (up to 10,000 at a time, undone in one step) through MCP, CLI, Python or REST. Every layer and word stays editable, and contrast, spacing and print readiness are checked before anything leaves the building. Posters, charts, decks, fillable PDFs and animation, each with its .vixl master.
product_description: Ask an AI for a poster and you usually get a picture of a poster. Vixl gives your agent the real thing. Text, shapes, images, masks, effects, variables and pages live in a layered .vixl document with branching history, so changing the date is one edit, not a whole new image. The same operations work across MCP, the command line, Python and REST. Start from scratch or from layouts, templates and reusable containers. Turn data into charts that open as real PowerPoint charts, draw routed diagrams, build decks with speaker notes, or make PDF forms people can actually fill in. Feed a typed recipe a CSV and get a checked campaign back. Animate with keyframes, posable characters, cameras and audio, and package app states with themes, transitions and reduced-motion stills. Write the brief as saved check suites, read the findings, look at the render, then export. Unpack any document into readable JSON and assets for Git review. Core authoring runs on your machine; AI generation and vision only use external providers you configure.

get_started:
Repository: https://github.com/jxburros/Vixl
Windows installer: https://github.com/jxburros/Vixl/releases/latest
Documentation: https://github.com/jxburros/Vixl/tree/main/docs
Developers: Python 3.11+, clone the repository, then python -m pip install -e '.[server,pdf]'.
In an existing workspace: vixl mcp --workspace . --tools core --schema slim

demo_script: 0:00–0:20 — Open the pack's overview. Say: Vixl is a design engine for AI agents. Everything in this pack was made with it, and the editable masters are included.

0:20–0:50 — Open the pitch deck's data slide in PowerPoint and use Edit Data to show the embedded workbook. Say: That is a real chart, not a screenshot of one. These numbers are illustrative workflow data, not customer results.

0:50–1:20 — Inspect campaign/campaign-recipe.vixl and campaign/posts.csv, then show campaign/source/project.json. Say: The source diffs in Git. Typed inputs, text fitting and saved checks turn three CSV rows into three posts, with no copy-paste.

1:20–1:45 — Open print/creative-brief-letter.pdf in a PDF viewer. Tab through the fields and type a project brief. Say: A useful intake worksheet, and a working fillable PDF made from Vixl field layers.

1:45–2:15 — Open app/package/index.html. Switch themes, then click create, deliver and reset. Turn on your OS reduced-motion setting to show the PNG fallback. Say: States, transitions, theme variables and reduced-motion stills all ship with editable masters.
2:15–2:40 — Play motion/teaser.mp4, then open proof.html. Say: Checks and a proper look at the render are part of delivery. A passing suite proves its rules; the preview is where we judge the design.

2:40–3:00 — Show the repository and getting-started documentation. Say: Grab the Windows installer or install from source with Python 3.11+, then connect through MCP, CLI, Python or REST. Vixl is source-available under PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0.
